plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Millersville University's official Coursedog catalog (catalog.millersville.edu); this plan's source_url is the program's official curriculum page. The live Undergraduate catalog page states: 'This publication is an announcement for the 2026-2027 academic year,' so this plan is filed under catalog year 2026-2027. The archived 2025-2026 catalog PDF's curriculum pages for these majors are blank, so the 2025-2026 tables could not be verified and were not used. The catalog publishes requirement tables only for this program: no official semester-by-semester sequence and no total degree credit figure appear on the program page, so this plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single requirements block, per the standing rule. The university-wide bachelor's minimum is 120 credits, including the Gateway General Education program (45-48 credits), which the program page does not itemize; the recorded total is the exact sum of the itemized major and required-related blocks transcribed here, not the 120-credit degree total. Coursedog display warning: each catalog block also shows a second 'Completion requirement' figure that in places disagrees with its block heading and row sums; headings and rows were transcribed as displayed and every disagreement affecting this plan is disclosed in these notes. 'Any X course(s)' pool rows on the catalog page show the summed credit value of the whole matching course pool, not a per-course credit; such blocks are recorded here as choice slots at the block's required credit amount. Major in Business Administration (42 credits): Business Foundations Block 9 (minimum grade C-), Business Core Requirements 24 (complete all, eight 3-credit courses), Departmental Electives 9 recorded as one choice slot. The page's inner line 'Requirements Fulfill all 36 cr' disagrees with its own sub-blocks (9+24+9 = 42) and is a Coursedog display error, disclosed here; the block headings and rows reconcile to 42. Concentration in General Business (15 credits): 'Electives for General Business, earn at least 15' from 300/400-level ACCT, FINA, MGMT, MKTG and INTB pools, recorded as one 15-credit choice slot (other printed options include BUSN488A and BUSN488B; internships/co-ops numbered 300 and 400 do not count as concentration electives but may be used as Departmental Electives). Catalog note: the Departmental Electives requirement may not be satisfied with BUSN 161, 162, 202, 206, 231, 251, 307, 341, 352, 358 or 455; declaring more than one business concentration, a second major, or a minor waives Departmental Electives. A grade of C- or higher is required in BUSN231, BUSN251 and BUSN341 as a prerequisite for upper-level courses in those areas. Required Related (10-13 credits): ECON 101 and ECON 102 (6, minimum grade C-), MATH 235 Survey of Statistics (3), and the Data Visualization and Communication requirement recorded as MATH 256 (4 credits; the printed alternative is MATH 279 Experimental, 1-4 credits); the page's inner 'Fulfill all 7-10 cr' line omits MATH 235 and is disclosed as a display error. Recorded total: 42 + 15 + 13 = 70 credits. The Lombardo College of Business publishes an official flowchart for this program (March 2025) organized by YEAR (freshman through senior), not by semester; it corroborates the course list above and additionally lists MATH 101 College Algebra as a prerequisite of BUSN 161, which the catalog's Required Related block does not list; MATH 101 is therefore not counted in this plan's total.

courses.title: Departmental Electives
courses.choice_note: Catalog block 'Departmental Electives (9 credits), earn at least 9 credits' from ACCT, BUSN, FINA, MGMT, MKTG, ACFN, MGMK, INTB or ITAN courses (pool totals shown on the page are not per-course credits). May not be satisfied with BUSN 161, 162, 202, 206, 231, 251, 307, 341, 352, 358 or 455; waived when a student declares more than one business concentration, a second major, or a minor.
